title: Ability to set custom middle click action with modifier key
line: The Task Manager can now do a different thing when you Ctrl+middle-click a task, set in its Behavior settings.
explanation: The Task Manager had a single middle-click action, so users had to choose between, for example, opening new windows and closing tasks with the middle button. Holding Ctrl while middle-clicking simply did the same as a plain middle-click. The change adds a "Ctrl+middle-clicking any task" setting with the same choices as the middle-click one; the click handler picks it when Ctrl is held.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: add a separate action for Ctrl+middle-click

Middle-clicking a task could only do one thing, so people who wanted to
both open new windows and close tasks with the middle button had to pick
one. Add a "Ctrl+middle-clicking any task" setting with the same choices.

BUG: 427088

media.caption: Behavior settings on master: only one middle-click action.
New "Ctrl+middle-clicking any task" setting under the middle-click one, here set to close.
Master: Ctrl+middle-clicking Konsole opens a second window, the same as a plain middle-click.
With the fix: plain middle-click still opened a new Konsole window, Ctrl+middle-click closed the whole Konsole group.
